verses.en: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.pt: Por que te conservas ao longe, Senhor? Por que te escondes em tempos de angústia?
verses.en_web: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
verses.en_bbe: Why do you keep far away, O Lord? why are you not to be seen in times of trouble?

verses.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.pt: Os ímpios, na sua arrogância, perseguem furiosamente o pobre; sejam eles apanhados nas ciladas que maquinaram.
verses.en_web: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doer in his pride is cruel to the poor; let him be taken by the tricks of his invention.

verses.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
verses.pt: Pois o ímpio gloria-se do desejo do seu coração, e o que é dado à rapina despreza e maldiz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy, and condemns Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For the evil-doer is lifted up because of the purpose of his heart, and he whose mind is fixed on wealth is turned away from the Lord, saying evil against him.

verses.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
verses.pt: Por causa do seu orgulho, o ímpio não o busca; todos os seus pensamentos são: Não há Deus.
verses.en_web: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doer in his pride says, God will not make a search. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

verses.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.pt: Os seus caminhos são sempre prósperos; os teus juízos estão acima dele, fora da sua vista; quanto a todos os seus adversários, ele os trata com desprezo.
verses.en_web: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is haughty, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
verses.en_bbe: His ways are ever fixed; your decisions are higher than he may see: as for his haters, they are as nothing to him.

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.pt: Diz em seu coração: Não serei abalado; nunca me verei na adversidade.
verses.en_web: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
verses.en_bbe: He has said in his heart, I will not be moved: through all generations I will never be in trouble.

verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.pt: A sua boca está cheia de imprecações, de enganos e de opressão; debaixo da sua língua há malícia e iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and false words: under his tongue are evil purposes and dark thoughts.

verses.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.pt: Põe-se de emboscada nas aldeias; nos lugares ocultos mata o inocente; os seus olhos estão de espreita ao desamparado.
verses.en_web: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
verses.en_bbe: He is waiting in the dark places of the towns: in the secret places he puts to death those who have done no wrong: his eyes are secretly turned against the poor.

verses.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.pt: Qual leão no seu covil, está ele de emboscada num lugar oculto; está de emboscada para apanhar o pobre; apanha-o, colhendo-o na sua rede.
verses.en_web: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he draws him in his net.
verses.en_bbe: He keeps himself in a secret place like a lion in his hole, waiting to put his hands on the poor man, and pulling him into his net.

verses.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.pt: Abaixa-se, curva-se; assim os desamparados lhe caem nas fortes garras.
verses.en_web: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
verses.en_bbe: The upright are crushed and made low, and the feeble are overcome by his strong ones.

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.pt: Diz ele em seu coração: Deus se esqueceu; cobriu o seu rosto; nunca verá isto.
verses.en_web: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
verses.en_bbe: He says in his heart, God has no memory of me: his face is turned away; he will never see it.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, Senhor; ó Deus, levanta a tua mão; não te esqueças dos necessitados.
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
verses.en_bbe: Up! O Lord; let your hand be lifted: give thought to the poor.

verses.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.pt: Por que blasfema de Deus o ímpio, dizendo no seu coração: Tu não inquirirás?
verses.en_web: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”
verses.en_bbe: Why has the evil-doer a low opinion of God, saying in his heart, You will not make search for it?

verses.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.pt: Tu o viste, porque atentas para o trabalho e enfado, para o tomares na tua mão; a ti o desamparado se entrega; tu és o amparo do órfão.
verses.en_web: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
verses.en_bbe: You have seen it; for your eyes are on sorrow and grief, to take it into your hand: the poor man puts his faith in you; you have been the helper of the child who has no father.

verses.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.pt: Quebra tu o braço do ímpio e malvado; esquadrinha a sua maldade, até que a descubras de todo.
verses.en_web: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
verses.en_bbe: Let the arm of the sinner and the evil-doer be broken; go on searching for his sin till there is no more.

verses.en: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.pt: O Senhor é Rei sempre e eternamente; da sua terra perecerão as nações.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations are gone from his land.

verses.en: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.pt: Tu, Senhor, ouvirás os desejos dos mansos; confortarás o seu coração; inclinarás o teu ouvido,
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
verses.en_bbe: Lord, you have given ear to the prayer of the poor: you will make strong their hearts, you will give them a hearing:

verses.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.pt: para fazeres justiça ao órfão e ao oprimido, a fim de que o homem, que é da terra, não mais inspire terror.
verses.en_web: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
verses.en_bbe: To give decision for the child without a father and for the broken-hearted, so that the man of the earth may no longer be feared.
